John B. Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 2010. The Society's profile page for him lists "ForMemRS, Elected 2010" ([royalsociety.org/people/11514](https://royalsociety.org/people/11514/)), and I confirmed the year with a web search. I did not reopen the University of Texas press release, so the May 2010 date from my earlier answer is unverified.

CONFIDENCE: 93
